question: Can a pure callback event log dominate the selected aggregate per-hash transactional overlay while preserving failure isolation?
decision: REJECT_EVENT_LOG_AS_DEFAULT. It wins the unique-hash metadata hostile but exports unbounded-by-unique-count event retention and loses by >2000x on a duplicate-heavy callback shape. Keep the aggregate live-object-reusing overlay as the workload-shape-robust default. The rollback-journal control remains the stronger fallback only if same-source product RSS rejects the isolated overlay.

productization_status.next: When ordinary source mutation is available, land only the preregistered Builder overlay + focused tests, then measure same-source archive/tree/wall/process-RSS before deciding whether the lower-memory rollback journal is needed.
